source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
hy brother

Big update — you now have access to B-roll footage to take your clips to the next level.

B-roll link: <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lPMIpcCWSCVVjehwoijwEuSb7mu-BmQO>

Here is what I need from you:

Create **5 perfect clips** using this B-roll footage alongside Teyron's long-form YouTube videos.

Every clip must follow these rules exactly:
\- 45 to 60 seconds minimum
\- Captures a complete moment — full lesson or story from start to finish
\- B-roll used naturally to support the message — not randomly placed
\- White text only — no colored fonts, no effects on text
\- Clean simple editing — no heavy animations, no flashy transitions
\- Background music at low volume — never louder than Teyron's voice
\- Standalone — someone who has never seen Teyron before watches it and understands it completely

**DEADLINE: Thursday.** I need to review and approve every clip before they go live Friday. That means I need them in my hands by Thursday morning — not Thursday night. If I do not have them by then they do not get posted this week.

Move fast. The B-roll is there to make the message more powerful — use it where it adds to the moment, not just to fill space.

Send your 5 clips as a Google Drive folder link with your name as the folder title. Set it to anyone with the link can view.

These are the first real clips going live. Make them perfect.

Cleavon

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey team,

First, sorry for the delay lately. Upwork had us on hold and we couldn't move as fast as we wanted. That's sorted now, so we're back to full speed.

While we were on hold, I put together a new system to make your job easier and help you hit your 100 approved clips faster.

Here's what's new:

1\. Clip variations - you can now take the same body clip and change just the hook/opening to make a new version. You can reuse one clip up to 2-3 times this way. Less work, more clips.

2\. Shorter clip styles - these are quicker to make and easier to combine, so reaching 100 approved clips will be a lot smoother. Some of you could even push past 200 if you want.

3\. Hook training video - I'm making a video showing you how to find strong hooks. One long video can give you close to 50 clip ideas. This will make finding content faster and easier.

We see the work, loyalty, and commitment you've all put in, even with the delays on our end, and we appreciate it. This new system is to help you earn more without extra headaches.

Looking ahead, we want to build you up into Lead Clippers as we grow and bring more people onto the team. That starts with mastering this new approach.

More details and examples coming soon. Let's get back to it.

\- Cleavon
